name: The Hero and the Azalea Blade
source:
Follow Halle the ex-hero in this slice of life story as she, along with some help from three possible characters, attempts to finally connect again with others her new home. Because maybe one day she'll put roots down again near others.

Despite her regrets and fears from her past.

[from [url=https://bibixp.itch.io/the-hero-and-the-azalea-blade]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个日常故事中，跟随昔日的英雄Halle，见证她在三位可选角色的帮助下，试着重新与新家园中的人们建立联系。也许有一天，她能再次在人群之中扎根。

即使过去的遗憾与恐惧，依然伴随着她。

[摘自[url=https://bibixp.itch.io/the-hero-and-the-azalea-blade]itch.io[/url]]
